finalText:
**Real scope: 75 service files. The rest must not move.**

| Zone | Files | Rename? |
|---|---|---|
| `services/*` JS vars | 75 | Yes, safe |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 12 | No, applied history |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 4 | No, regenerated |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 1 | No, frozen contract |
| `lib/serialize.js` | 1 | No, wire name |

Three more traps inside the 75. SQL strings like `WHERE account_id = ?` are column names, not vars. `req.session.account_id` is a session field. `audit()` writes an `account_id` log key.

So it is a local variable and parameter rename only. Every boundary keeps the old name. Want me to do the safe pass?
